svg.aria-label: A small assistant drawn as a controller, in the Studio's title bar. Tell it in your own words how you play and it sets your PC mode for you: stick and trigger curves, dead zones, hair triggers, turbo,
svg.text: A small assistant drawn as a controller, in the Studio's title bar. Tell it in your own words how you play and it
sets your PC mode for you: stick and trigger curves, dead zones, hair triggers, turbo, remaps, mouse mode,
and measuring stick drift. It checks every request against fixed rules before it changes anything, shows exactly
what changed, and has an Undo. It also answers questions about the app from these docs. Spelling and
grammar don't matter: it works out what you meant and tells you how it read it. It runs on your PC with
nothing to install, and nothing you type leaves it. Type
to see everything it can do.
